correctness.rationale: PASS. The exactly lumped source-pinned K_{n,n} generator is births lambda y(n-1-x), lambda(x+1)(n-y), deaths x,y; the finite process is irreducible for lambda>0. With a_n=n lambda=1+c/sqrt n, S=x+y, D=x-y, exact algebra gives B=a_n(S+1)-lambda[(S-D)+(S²-D²)/2] and L D=-(1+a_n)D-a_n. Stationary D and D² equations imply E D²=O(E S+1), and the stationary S balance yields E S²=O(n), hence W=S/sqrt n tight with uniform-integrable means and D/sqrt n->0 in L². Multiplying the W generator by sqrt n gives weak stationary diffusion equation ∫[(1+cw-w²/2)f'(w)+w f''(w)]dν=0. On (0,∞), zero flux forces density proportional exp(cw-w²/4). The boundary test-function derivative and integrable speed solution force no atom at 0 and zero stationary flux; Z_c=sqrt(pi)exp(c²)(1+erf c). This uniquely identifies convergence of W and mean 2c+2 exp(-c²)/(sqrt pi(1+erf c)). Own independent finite stationary chain calculations at n=10,20,35 agree with drift identities and normalization. No time-dependent diffusion limit from arbitrary starts or nonfixed offsets is claimed.
